type: controlled candidate causal test, fail-fast gated
pre_registered_intervention: Restore WHEAT_FLOOR_MIN_TILES/PER_ANIMAL/MAX_TILES in V10.6 from (0,0.0,0) to v8.11's historical (3,0.4,6), no other change.

candidate.diff_from_v10_6: 3-line change only: WHEAT_FLOOR_MIN_TILES 0->3, WHEAT_FLOOR_PER_ANIMAL 0.0->0.4, WHEAT_FLOOR_MAX_TILES 0->6 (with updated inline comments); no other line differs.

gate: MANDATORY SEED-920 GATE: candidate terminal cash must exceed V10.6 vanilla terminal cash to proceed past Phase 2.
root_cause_found: want["WHEAT"] was deleted from the seed-buying dict at v9.1 (comment at file header line 71: 'Wheat PLANTING removed entirely: want["WHEAT"] deleted, wheat-floor constants zeroed'). Since BUY_SEED is only ever issued for crops present as a key in `want`, seeds.get("WHEAT",0) is provably always 0 in V10.6. plantable_crops() filters on seeds.get(c,0) > 0, so WHEAT can never appear in the plantable set regardless of plant_priority_current order. The wheat-floor priority-reorder block (lines ~1898-1903) is therefore structurally dead code independent of the WHEAT_FLOOR_* constant values -- restoring the constants alone cannot change behavior.
phase_2_classification: EXACT TIE (candidate terminal cash == vanilla, byte-identical action hash across the whole game) -> per fail-fast rule, NOT REJECTED (not worse) and NOT CANDIDATE_VALIDATED (not better) -> classify per the 'exactly equal' branch: NO_LARGE_OPPORTUNITY_FOUND, since the identical-outcome result is fully explained by a directly-observed structural cause (dead code), not an unexplained wash.

phases_skipped.Phase 3: skipped -- only run when Phase 2 is positive (candidate beats vanilla); here it was an exact tie, not a win
phases_skipped.Phase 5: skipped -- only run when Phase 2 is positive

correction_note: V2_10A and V2_10F characterized V10.6's WHEAT-floor formula as having 'no MAX_TILES cap' (i.e., only 2 constants). Verified directly in this experiment: V10.6 in fact has all THREE constants (WHEAT_FLOOR_MIN_TILES, WHEAT_FLOOR_PER_ANIMAL, WHEAT_FLOOR_MAX_TILES), all zeroed, consumed by the same 3-argument min(MAX, max(MIN, ceil(n*PER))) formula as v8.11. This is a correction to the prior record, not a new finding about the mechanism's dormancy.
